# Original music sources

[MegaBenchOS](../../README.md) / [Music](../../music/README.md) / Original sources

These folders preserve source files and provenance separately from generated ROM assets. Original upstream READMEs remain unchanged.

- [Safety Stoat upstream README](safetystoat/README.md) and [source folder](safetystoat/): the collection used by the current library.
- [Previous MegaPlayer selections](safetystoat/archive/README.md): additional licensed source files.
- [Beatscribe upstream README](beatscribe/UPSTREAM_README.md) and [source folder](beatscribe/): converter fixture and original notices.

Use [current track credits](../../music/CREDITS.md) to identify what actually ships, and the [conversion guide](../../docs/MUSIC_CONVERSION.md) to rebuild compatible assets.

## Licensing

Preserve the original licences and manifests in each source folder. [Current credits](../../music/CREDITS.md) and [third-party notices](../../THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md) record redistribution evidence.
